content.text:
All three generator files were only touched by `cfeac1a` (initial add), `251ad37` (the encoding property rename), `2126614` (unrelated, presumably), and `c395707` (the fix). This confirms `251ad37` is the single commit that introduced the `OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING` split (hardcoded to the string `"html.outputEncoding"`/`"html.sourceEncoding"`) and rewired every call site (`html`, `txt`, `xml` report generators) to use `getOutputEncoding()` instead of the generic `getOutEncoding()`, exactly the set of changes that `c395707` reverses.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 251ad374cb1027de108590bef75508f4f497b375

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log` on the files touched by the fix (`IReportProperties.java`, `ReportProperties.java`, and the `html`/`txt`/`xml` `ReportGenerator.java` files) to find their full modification history. Each file only has a handful of commits: the initial add (`cfeac1a`), the encoding-property rename (`251ad37`), an unrelated commit (`2126614`), and the fix itself (`c395707`). I then diffed `251ad37` against `c395707` directly.

**(2) The change that introduced the bug:** Commit `251ad37` ("addition parameters by terry") replaced the single, generic `report.<type>.out.encoding` property (`OUT_ENCODING`, backed by `m_outEncoding`/`getOutEncoding()`/`setOutEncoding()`) with two new properties hardcoded to the string literals `"html.outputEncoding"` and `"html.sourceEncoding"` (`OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING`), and rewired every call site in the `html`, `txt`, and `xml` report generators to use `getOutputEncoding()`/`getSourceEncoding()` instead. Because the property keys are literally prefixed with `html.` regardless of the actual report type, and because there is no default value supplied (`getReportProperty(..., false, false)` with no `dflt`), the encoding lookups for `txt`/`xml` reports (and any user relying on the previously documented `out.encoding` setting) silently break/return null, producing incorrect or missing encoding for report generation.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** `git diff 251ad37 c395707` shows the fix is essentially a near-exact inverse of `251ad37`'s changes — restoring `OUT_ENCODING`/adding `IN_ENCODING` with proper generic property names, removing the `html.`-hardcoded `OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING` constants, and reverting all `getOutputEncoding()`/`getSourceEncoding()` call sites in the three `ReportGenerator` classes back to `getOutEncoding()`/`getInEncoding()`. No other commit in the file histories touches these encoding-related properties, so `251ad37` is the sole introducer of the bug that `c395707` fixes.

I'm confident in this identification since the fix commit's diff is essentially a targeted revert of `251ad37`'s specific changes, with no other intervening commits touching this code path.
